11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)
the owner's naming rule (2026-11-15): a person the draft names by role is a cast villager, named at the first mention

collection.description: A villager has written a very long list of things to do today, and by midday has only written the list.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has written a list of everything (subject.he/she) intends to accomplish today. It is impressively long. It includes repairing a basket, gathering herbs, cleaning the hut, visiting a friend, and learning how to whistle like a particular bird. By midday, (subject) has accomplished precisely one thing: writing the list.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) crosses out "learn to whistle." After several attempts, (subject.he/she) produces a noise resembling an unhappy duck. A nearby bird answers. (subject) decides this counts.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) folds the list and goes for a walk. Along the way (subject.he/she) helps (neighbor), a neighbor, finds a beautiful shell, and enjoys an excellent lunch. None of these things were on the list. (subject) decides it was a good day anyway.
